summary_1line: At Draupadi’s swayamvara, Arjuna—disguised as a Brahmana—strings the impossible bow and strikes the target, winning her after many kings fail.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, disguised as a Brahmana youth, calmly strings the massive bow before a stunned assembly of kings.
Arjuna releases five arrows through the rotating device, striking the distant target as flowers rain from the sky.
Krishna approaches the victorious Arjuna in the arena, offering a white robe and garland while the crowd erupts in celebration.
